lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.description: Served probability plus fitted rule-minus-pooled term vs served probability recalibrated alone, cover log loss, LOSO 2015-2021
lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.notes: 2 of 7 seasons positive; decisive games where the side differs from served: 58-49
lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.plain_summary: Adding the rule-era shape reading to the model's cover chance gave a tiny, uncertain gain over just rescaling the model's confidence.

lead76_rule_vs_pooled_prior_cover.notes: Fitted era weight near 0 in every fold; 3 of 7 seasons positive; effect far below detectable size
